function: Jointly optimizes transmit beamforming (common, private, sensing), common rate allocation and BD-RIS reflection matrix to maximize the sum rate under target SCNR and user rate constraints (p. 2-3).
system: RSMA downlink ISAC for URLLC: BS ULA NT=NR=8, K=4 single-antenna users, V=2 clutters, group-connected BD-RIS M=20 (groups of 4); frequency band not stated (p. 2, 4).
method: Meta-PPO: actor-critic PPO (MLPs, two hidden layers of 64) with meta-training over tasks and a meta-adaptation stage; reinforcement and meta-learning, 30,000 training episodes (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Own simulator: BS-user Rayleigh; BD-RIS-user and BS-BD-RIS Rician (factor 10); distance path loss; bounded CSI errors (0.4 of channel norm); no dataset or measurements (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Training: 30,000 episodes of 100 steps, users re-drawn randomly in a semicircle at each step; results swept over M, blocklength, rth; no separate unseen-scenario test reported (p. 4-5).
baselines: Learned: DDPG, TD3, SAC, PPO, A2C; non-learned: alternating optimization (AO), random phase shift, no RIS; system variants: conventional RIS, SDMA, NOMA, communication-only, perfect CSI (p. 4).
metrics: Average reward (equals sum rate when constraints hold), average sum rate versus M and blocklength, PDF of target SCNR, convergence over episodes (p. 3-5).
complexity: none; only the qualitative remark that larger BD-RIS groups increase computational complexity (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "The BS-user channel follows a Rayleigh fading model"; BD-RIS links are Rician with factor 10 and a simple distance path loss; custom simulator, no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 4: "The agent can rapidly adapt to unseen environments by integrating Meta-learning into the PPO algorithm" is a method claim only; tasks Q are never defined and no result (pp. 4-5) tests a scenario absent from training.
q3_support: p. 4: "DRL-based baselines: Employ deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG), twin delayed DDPG (TD3), soft actor critic (SAC)" and "achieves the highest reward among the compared algorithms"; p. 5: "Under ICSI, the proposed Meta-PPO model significantly outperforms the AO method".
q4_support: p. 5: "at the expense of increased computational complexity" is the only remark on cost; no complexity order, FLOPs, parameter count or runtime is reported (p. 4 gives only the MLP size).
q5_support: p. 4: "The remaining simulation parameters and PPO training settings are summarized in Table I"; own simulator, no code or data link and no public dataset.
notes: Area 5: beamforming of an ISAC system (sensing beam and SCNR constraint C1, pp. 2-3). q2 is borderline: meta-adaptation to unseen environments is described (p. 4, Eq. 18) but no adaptation or unseen-scenario test is reported. q3: the learned comparison in Fig. 2(a) is on average reward, which equals the sum rate when constraints hold (p. 3); the non-learned ones (AO, random phase shift, no RIS) are on sum rate in Figs. 2(b)-(c).
